title: Balanced Brackets
summary: Use a stack to decide whether every opening bracket is closed in the correct order.
motivation: One focused problem today keeps your problem-solving momentum alive.

blocks.content: Read a string containing only `()`, `[]`, and `{}`. Print `Balanced` when every opening bracket has a matching closing bracket in the correct order. Otherwise, print `Not Balanced`.

blocks.caption: Nested bracket pairs close in reverse order.

blocks.title: Constraints
blocks.content: The input contains between 1 and 10,000 bracket characters. No spaces or other characters are included.

blocks.starterCode:
brackets = input().strip()
stack = []
pairs = {')': '(', ']': '[', '}': '{'}

# Check whether the brackets are balanced
